installed_before_test.notes: The preexisting desktop application was preserved and was never launched or controlled for this probe. No installed agy command was found.

temporary_official_cli.cleanup_note: Recursive temporary-folder cleanup was rejected by automatic approval review (blocked by policy). Parent then requested retaining the verified binary for login capability tests; no cleanup retries performed.

cli_checks.notes: The official CLI accepts the repository's prompt/model/permission flag family. Its executable is agy.exe, not the preexisting desktop Antigravity.exe. The current binary advertises an unlimited default print timeout; use an explicit dispatcher deadline.

command: Reply exactly AGENTHUB_WINDOWS_OK. Do not use tools, read or write files, execute commands, or access external websites.
generation_probe.error: FAILED_PRECONDITION (code 400): User location is not supported for the API use.
generation_probe.cleanup: A Windows Job Object with kill-on-close owned only the probe process and its descendants. Closing it reclaimed those processes. Preexisting apps and services were preserved.
generation_probe.interpretation: Native CLI launch, flags, headless response transport and nonzero provider-error reporting were verified on Windows. Successful inference was not verified because the provider rejected this machine's region. An isolated filesystem profile does not isolate Windows Credential Manager; official CLI may read a preexisting desktop login silently. No sign-in, sign-out or authentication configuration changes were performed.

static_dispatch_findings.finding: The async_default branch returns before cwd/workdir_via/executable resolution. Its task JSON contains only cmd and callback_url, so caller cwd and timeout_s cannot reach async_worker.
static_dispatch_findings.runtime_validation: Delegated to the parent agent's central subprocess probe.

static_dispatch_findings.finding: run_cmd_mode has no execution deadline and marks every returned exit code as completed, including provider errors such as agy exit 3.
static_dispatch_findings.runtime_validation: Delegated to the parent agent's central subprocess probe.

static_dispatch_findings.finding: CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP is used, but Windows cleanup falls back to terminate/kill of the root process only; it also returns immediately if that root has exited. Descendants may survive. A Windows Job Object or other verified tree cleanup is needed.
static_dispatch_findings.runtime_validation: Static review; this vendor probe independently used a Job Object for its own cleanup.

static_dispatch_findings.finding: No general Windows wrapper normalization exists. .ps1 requires an explicit PowerShell interpreter; the async branch also lacks shutil.which resolution. .cmd lookup/quoting needs a runtime check, and blanket shell=True is unsafe with user prompt arguments.
static_dispatch_findings.runtime_validation: Not claimed as a .cmd runtime failure here; parent agent handles subprocess shim tests.

static_dispatch_findings.finding: Output is decoded as UTF-8 with replacement, but child encoding is not normalized. Python or shell workers using a Windows code page can produce replacement characters; setting parent file encoding alone does not change bytes emitted by a child.
static_dispatch_findings.runtime_validation: Static review; agy returned valid UTF-8 for this English diagnostic.
